mapper.sql: student.id AS student_id, student.student_name, student_user.id AS student_user_id, student_user.username AS student_account, enrollment_organization.id AS organization_id, enrollment_organization.organization_name

FROM edu_student student JOIN sys_user student_user ON student_user.id = student.student_user_id AND student_user.user_type = 'STUDENT' AND student_user.status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_user_role student_user_role ON student_user_role.user_id = student_user.id JOIN sys_role student_role ON student_role.id = student_user_role.role_id AND student_role.role_code = 'STUDENT' AND student_role.status = 'ENABLED' JOIN edu_student_organization enrollment ON enrollment.student_id = student.id AND enrollment.relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' AND enrollment.status = 'INACTIVE' AND enrollment.id = ( SELECT latest_enrollment.id FROM edu_student_organization latest_enrollment WHERE latest_enrollment.student_id = student.id AND latest_enrollment.relation_type = 'ENROLLMENT' ORDER BY latest_enrollment.updated_at DESC, latest_enrollment.id DESC LIMIT 1 ) JOIN sys_organization enrollment_organization ON enrollment_organization.id = enrollment.organization_id AND enrollment_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' JOIN sys_organization_admin organization_admin ON organization_admin.user_id = #{operatorUserId} JOIN sys_organization managed_organization ON managed_organization.id = organization_admin.organization_id AND managed_organization.status = 'ENABLED' AND managed_organization.effective_status = 'ENABLED' WHERE student.status = 'ENABLED' AND enrollment_organization.organization_path LIKE CONCAT(managed_organization.organization_path, '%') AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_student_organization active_organization WHERE active_organization.student_id = student.id AND active_organization.status = 'ACTIVE' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM edu_parent_student active_parent WHERE active_parent.student_id = student.id AND active_parent.status = 'ACTIVE' )

AND student.id = #{studentId} ORDER BY enrollment_organization.id LIMIT 1

AND student.id = #{studentId} ) candidate ORDER BY candidate.organization_id LIMIT 1
